name: kinetic-slider-rail
title: Kinetic Slider Rail
description: A continuous range slider with elastic thumb drag that snaps into discrete calibrated detents upon release.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Slider Rail Drag Detent: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
